The Hebrew letter **Mem** (מ) is the 13th letter of the Hebrew alphabet, carrying the sound **"m"** and a numerical value (gematria) of **40**.[[1]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137085/jewish/Mem.htm)

### Key Characteristics & Forms

- **Sound & Value:** Makes an "m" sound and equals 40 in gematria.[[1]](https://hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Mem/mem.html)[[2]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137085/jewish/Mem.htm)
- **Two Forms:** 
	- **Open Mem (מ):** Used at the beginning or middle of a word; features a small opening at the bottom-left, symbolizing revealed wisdom or flowing water.
	- **Closed Mem or *Mem Sofit* (ם):** Used exclusively at the very end of a word; forms a closed square, symbolizing hidden or concealed truths.[[1]](https://inner.org/hebleter/mem.htm)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ivMqgpkiFCw)[[3]](https://hebrew4christians.com/Grammar/Unit_One/Aleph-Bet/Mem/mem.html)
- **Meaning:** The name *Mem* derives from *mayim* (מַיִם), the Hebrew word for water. The word *mayim* itself is constructed using both forms of the letter with a *Yud* in the middle (מ-י-ם).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ivMqgpkiFCw)[[2]](https://agapegeek.com/2022/09/30/jesus-in-the-ancient-hebrew-alphabet-part-14-the-mem-part-1-the-blood/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2mGg-g5XpAg&t=43)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v_k7BqCu8Jg)
- **Symbolism of 40:** The number 40 represents periods of testing, ripening, or major transformation—such as the 40 days of rain in the Flood, Moses staying on Mount Sinai for 40 days, the 40 years of desert wandering, and the 40 *se'ah* of water required for a ritual immersion pool (*mikveh*).[[1]](https://www.sefaria.org/sheets/179212)[[2]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137085/jewish/Mem.htm)

Learn more about its deeper mystical traditions on [Chabad.org](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137085/jewish/Mem.htm) or explore the visual artwork and teachings at [Gabriele Levy](https://gabrielelevy.com/pages/the-letter-mem).[[1]](https://www.chabad.org/library/article_cdo/aid/137085/jewish/Mem.htm)[[2]](https://gabrielelevy.com/pages/the-letter-mem)If you'd like, I can share:

- **How to handwrite** both the open and closed forms step-by-step
- **Famous Hebrew words** that start or end with Mem
